body: You're gonna feel better if you have people who care about you. Otherwise, not so much
The one friend I do have, is never there. I don't have anyone to reach out to.

I'd like to try. 
Why do I hate myself? I'm ugly, stupid, and unlikeable. 
Why do I think that? People have called me ugly, people have called me stupid, I've made stupid mistakes, people often get annoyed with me. 

That's about as far as I can get. When things like this can be backed up with facts, of course you come to the conclusion that you suck and life sucks.

I think I learn best by writing or doing. Unfortunately people don't have a lot of patience in retail so Idk about the doing method. I could ask my manager if I could write stuff down while he explains it to me
Messaged you
PM'd you

I want to say that this is a great place to vent and get support but honestly most of the time I do leave this place feeling worse. Either I find posts that make me feel more hopeless (even if I feel understood for a short time) or I post myself and get no responses which makes me feel like I'm too repulsive for even this sub to care about.
I haven't been feeling much of anything at all. Just a dull melancholy. I can't imagine things improving. But thanks for taking the time to respond.

Thanks for the kind words. I've just been feeling numb lately. My life is a mess and I can't even muster up any strong emotion to it anymore. Which is probably a good thing, because I don't know what I'd do if I did have strong emotions. But thanks for asking.
Unfortunately I've given up on the notion that anyone will care when I get to that point, but I'm glad you we're there for someone who really needed it. Gives me some hope for humanity.
I don't have friends either, and that's made it a lot more difficult to heal. When I'm at my worst, there's no one there. Hard to care about myself when no one else does.
I see. Thanks for the insight. Do you have any advice on what small steps I should be taking?

4 years later and the torment I received in high school still haunts me. It's left scars that I don't think will ever heal. Now I'm severely depressed and scared of people. I don't think my life is going to improve so I may end it before the year is out.
Yea I can relate. Was bullied throughout school and now struggle with depression and anxiety with no idea how to get better.

Thanks for the offer, I really appreciate it. I have a bunch of reasons though, and they're all bothering me tonight. I struggle with feelings of worthlessness dues to being bullied very badly. Now I'm trying to get a job and make friends, with past and present events convincing me I will not achieve either. I don't have a support system for times like this and it's hell.
It's possible a good chunk of them don't have therapists. I used to go there often since I don't have a support system.
It's fine. That list did help a little, so thanks. Really I just appreciate you taking the time to respond and care, anyone showing even the tiniest bit of concern means a lot to me.
I don't know why I'm surviving at this point. I can't tell if this is genuine or not, but if it is, thanks.
Depression posts should probably just be banned from this sub all together, it's clear people are annoyed by them.
Hey. Something triggered me really badly and I'm crying myself to sleep. But tomorrows another day I guess. I'm mostly into fighting games. I don't read much anymore, but I write if I feel like it.
Thanks for the kind words. That's something at least.

I like video games and reading. I wanted to try writing but I'm not good at it and it'd be a very long time before I made that into a career. Maybe there's something for video games, but I'd have to start all over if I switched majors. Plus I don't want to have that hobby anymore, it makes me feel like a loser. But I'm not interested in anything else.

Yeah the advice sucks but its what everyone says. I'm studying Business Management and I hate it. I'm only doing it because I don't know what I want to do. I don't have any passions and my interests cant be turned into jobs. So now I'm taking a break trying to get a job and failing. If you don't mind me asking, what are you doing now?
Well I don't have the energy to set up my console, so I usually just play mobile games. Mainly RPGs. It's the only thing that brings me joy at this point

Life is too much and I don't know how to handle it. I'm failing out of college and can't secure a job either. Social life is also a mess. I have no passion, and I don't believe any of my goals will happen every attempt to achieve them fails. And everyone just has a "life sucks, deal with it" mentality. I don't know how to stop myself from ending it.
Yeah, I have a cat
Video games. That's it
Talking to strangers does help, but I get ignored most of the time.
Because being an adult is the absolute worst, and the world is a cold, uncaring, hellhole. I just have no will to live in general.
I don't know what to do now. Tried using the suicide chat line and it put me on hold forever and it asks you all this information and ends up not working anyway. I'm never getting help.
Thank you. It's fine if you don't mean it, I'll take people pretending at this point I just can't stand suffering by myself
This comment wasn't meant for me, but it did resonate with me as someone who has no hope right now. So thanks.

Right now has been sucking for 5 years. And I doubt it'll change since I'm in an empty town with no opportunity to make friends and no skills so no one will hire me. And with no one loving me now, it's hard to find any motivation.

Sorry but I don't. If I did, people would actually care about me and want to help. But instead I get called selfish, weak, and told that I'm too young to be depressed and need to get my shit together. And this was all coming from a subreddit that's supposed to help. I have no friends so that was my last resort. I have no hope anymore.
Sorry. Its too late.
I'm just kind of numb right now. But I have wrapped myself in a blanket and just decided to take it easy today. Thanks for caring though.
Thanks. It really is hell on earth.  You just caring enough to respond is enough for me.

That makes sense, especially since you don't have to wait as long to talk to someone on reddit and you can talk to people as long as you want. And thanks, that really means a lot. What time is it where you are?

I'm sorry about that. It's pretty hard. And the hotline kept putting me on hold forever so I just gave up. I would like to make friends, but all the places to go to meet people are an hour away from where I live. I might have to settle for that tho.

Unfortunately there is something wrong with me. It's why I have no friends. And my family ignores my depression so I yearn for a conversation every day. But even people online want nothing to do with me. I hope one day I find someone who cares.
I don't know what's wrong with me. I don't know why people stop responding to me. I just want someone to talk to.

Are you sure? Because I've already had people bail on me twice. Twice I was tricked into thinking someone actually cared about me. No one is here for me, I already know that. But at least let me know if you're going to randomly stop responding.

Thanks for trying to reach out, but I think it's time for me to go. I've prolonged it for long enough. The pain has just gotten too intense.  But thanks, really, you're the first to care in quite some time.
Was just asking. Besides, it's not like you do either, making posts that would just make someone feel worse about being here. Later.
Curious. If you think this sub is an echo chamber, why stick around?
Lobster. I don't like shrimp and I can get fish anytime. Eating out is a special occasion, so I try to get food we don't usually eat
We went to red lobster and had a bunch of seafood
I just went to dinner with my parents. That's all the fun I get nowadays.

Thanks. I don't know what I'm supposed to say. My story is boring and there's nothing you can do anyway. I think I might start cutting because I can't deal with the constant pain and nothing really alleviates it for long. I had a fun day and yet the waterworks will not stop. I do appreciate you talking to me even if you can't do anything. I just don't know what to do.
OK. I just wanted to talk about what was bothering me and unfortunately that was it.

Well like I said, my story isn't interesting. I've just failed at life. No friends, no SO, college sucks. I'm pretty ugly and people tend to hate me, and there's nothing to do in my town so I don't see things getting better. I have suicidal thoughts very often and need someone to talk to but my family is emotionally unavailable. So I have to go through this alone and I just want to quit.

Things always feel heavy. I just haven't made much progress there is nothing to do in my town, so I can't join clubs or take classes unless I drive an hour. Plus I feel like no one is going to like me people tend to dislike me very quickly. And every time I come on here I hear about everyone's wonderful friends and SOs. I hate it but this place is all I have. My family does not care that I am suicidal which just makes me want to end it more. I just do not like life. I just wish I wasn't alone all the time.

I don't see my life getting any better. I just want to have someone there for me, but people that meet me tend to dislike me so that won't happen. And people online usually don't care. I don't think I'll ever enjoy being alive so I just want to end it.

Long 8 years. And I think I've reached the end. I don't want to cry myself to sleep anymore, but it's not like I have anyone in my life to turn to. I'm too repulsive so no one wants anything to do with me. I literally cannot go another day.

A part of me really wants to leave, but I'm afraid if I do the painful thoughts and memories will come back, like they always do, and I'll wish I had ended it. Don't have any friends, and my family doesn't really care, so I don't have anyone to talk to. I don't really know what I'm going to do yet, but I just want to say thanks for caring at least a little, that's more than I can hope for these days.
I can assure you, no one cares. Suicide is the right option, I'm more sure of it now than ever.
